entry.name: RTX_GEAR_STATE_TRANSITION
entry.description: Requested and reported gear states do not match.

entry.name: CAMERA_OA_SECTOR_FLAGS_MASK_VALID
entry.description: The newest frame produced a valid water mask, so free sectors are positive evidence. Clear for a box detector, whose free sectors only mean "no detection".

entry.name: CAMERA_OA_SECTOR_FLAGS_ATTITUDE_VALID
entry.description: Vehicle attitude was available at capture time; without it the map's bearings are not compass-stabilised.

entry.name: CAMERA_OA_TARGET_FLAGS_RANGE_TRUSTED
entry.description: range_m is within the pipeline's trusted range; clear = bearing-only, range_m a rough estimate.

entry.name: CAMERA_OA_TARGET_FLAGS_SELECTED
entry.description: Set by the autopilot on the copy it forwards to the GCS: this is the target the operator selected.

entry.name: CAMERA_OA_TARGET_FLAGS_POSITION_VALID
entry.description: Set by the autopilot on the copy it forwards to the GCS: lat/lon hold the target's position (vehicle position + range along the bearing at arrival).

enum.name: CAMERA_OA_TARGET_STATE
enum.description: State of the operator's target selection and of the vehicle's follow mode (ATTACK), in CAMERA_OA_TARGET_SELECT.

entry.name: CAMERA_OA_TARGET_STATE_NONE
entry.description: No target selected: the companion reports every target.

entry.name: CAMERA_OA_TARGET_STATE_SELECTED
entry.description: Target selected, vehicle not in the follow mode.

entry.name: CAMERA_OA_TARGET_STATE_FOLLOWING
entry.description: Vehicle approaching / keeping station at the standoff distance.

entry.name: CAMERA_OA_TARGET_STATE_HOLD_LOST
entry.description: Target lost (no report within the timeout) or camera link lost: vehicle holding until the operator decides.

entry.name: CAMERA_OA_TARGET_STATE_HOLD_CLOSE
entry.description: Target inside the standoff distance, or its range cannot be trusted close in: vehicle stopped.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_CAMERA_OA_TARGET
entry.description: Select a camera target (CAMERA_OA_TARGET.target_id) for the follow mode (ATTACK): the autopilot accepts only a target reported within the last seconds and tells the companion to track only that one. The vehicle keeps at least the standoff distance from it; the autopilot enforces a 10 m minimum whatever is asked.
entry.param: Standoff distance; 0 = the vehicle's default (ATCK_STANDOFF). Never below 10 m.
1: also switch to the follow mode (ATTACK).

message.name: CAMERA_OA_OBSTACLE
message.description: One tracked obstacle from the companion-computer camera pipeline. Geometry plus advisory tracking fields; the autopilot computes all control decisions itself and never acts on cpa_m, tcpa_s or risk_score directly.
message.field: Capture timestamp on the companion computer clock. Logging only.
Persistent id of this object across frames.
Body-relative bearing, 0 dead ahead, positive to starboard.
1 if range_m is within the pipeline's trusted range and the waterline and size methods agree; 0 if bearing-only and range_m is a rough estimate.
Advisory closest point of approach from the pipeline's relative-motion track. Negative if unknown.
Advisory time to closest point of approach. Negative or 655.35 if diverging or unknown.
Consecutive frames this track has been seen in.
0 unknown, 1 large vessel, 2 small boat, 3 buoy, 4 static structure, 5 shore (a wide static contact from the water segmentation; the autopilot keeps a larger standoff from it).

message.name: CAMERA_OA_STATUS
message.description: Companion-computer camera pipeline heartbeat and health, sent at a fixed rate whether or not any obstacle is detected. The autopilot's watchdog keys off this message.
message.field: 1 if the vision pipeline is healthy, 0 on dropped frames, stale attitude, calibration or any other fault.

message.name: CAMERA_OA_SECTORS
message.description: Compass-stabilised obstacle map from the companion-computer camera pipeline: the full circle in equal-angle sectors, world bearings, accumulated and filtered over time at the sensor so that one message is a clean picture, not a frame. Sector i spans [bearing0 + i*width, bearing0 + (i+1)*width). The autopilot builds its avoidance rose from this and decides itself.
message.field: Capture timestamp of the newest frame in the map, companion computer clock. Logging only.
Vehicle yaw the sensor used for the newest frame, 0..36000. Consistency check and logging only.
World bearing of the start edge of sector 0, 0..36000 (0 = north).
Sectors in use, at most 120. count * sector_cd normally covers the full circle.
Working range of the map. A contact beyond it is reported as far (254): bearing known, range not usable. A free sector was seen clear to this range.

Per sector: 0 unknown (never observed, or forgotten); 1..200 nearest contact at range = value * 0.5 m (to 100 m), 201..250 at 100 m + (value - 200) * 2 m (to 200 m); 254 contact beyond working_m (bearing-only); 255 seen free to working_m.

message.name: CAMERA_OA_TARGET
message.description: One stable target (vessel) from the companion-computer camera pipeline, candidate for the operator's target selection. The companion sends it; the autopilot keeps a table, places the target (lat/lon) and forwards it to the GCS. Geometry only: the autopilot decides every motion itself.
message.field: Capture timestamp, companion computer clock. Logging only.
Stable id of the target across frames (tracker id), 1..65535; 0 invalid.
World bearing from the vehicle to the target, 0..36000 (0 = north), from the vehicle yaw at capture.
Estimated range; negative if unknown (bearing only).
Estimated real-world width; negative if unknown.
Target latitude. 0 from the companion; filled by the autopilot on the copy it forwards (flag POSITION_VALID).
Target longitude. 0 from the companion; filled by the autopilot on the copy it forwards.
0 unknown, 1 large vessel, 2 small boat, 3 buoy, 4 static structure (as CAMERA_OA_OBSTACLE.obstacle_class).
How long this id has been tracked, saturating at 255.

message.name: CAMERA_OA_TARGET_SELECT
message.description: The operator's target selection and the follow mode's state, sent by the autopilot to the companion and to the GCS, on every change and at 1 Hz. The companion then tracks and reports only target_id, except with target_id 0 (no selection) or state HOLD_LOST (the selection is lost): then it reports every target again, so the operator can choose the next one, and keeps the lost id should it come back.
message.field: Last range to the selected target; negative if unknown.
